title: Emod table round
statement: A table round stores the product of `Mult` and the sum of `Free` and `Count` at the memory address given by that sum, then increments `Count` by one and doubles `Mult`.
caveat: The payload omits the definitions of the Emod variables and arithmetic-expression notation, so their intended meanings are inferred from their names and use.
